newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BENFICA SEEKING TO BUY FEYENOORD'S TAUMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA SEEKING TO BUY FEYENOORD'S TAUMENT.

text.p: Benfica, in need of a goal-scoring talent to revitalise a disappointing season, are negotiating to buy Dutch striker Gaston Taument from Feyenoord, a club spokesman said on Wednesday.
Taument will travel to Lisbon next week for medical tests after which he could sign a four-year contract, the spokesman said.
He did not say how much Benfica, currently third in the Portuguese league, were prepared to pay for the striker.

Benfica began the season hoping to mount a serious challenge to champions Porto. But the northern club look to be cruising to their third successive championship with a 15-point lead over Lisbon's Sporting, who are in turn one point ahead of Benfica.
